changelog:
🚀 New Features & Enhancements
• Cloudflare R2 Pull-Through Worker Cache: High-performance edge cache for email template images with jsDelivr origin fallback and automatic TTL pruning to conserve capacity.
• Preview & Drip Harmonization: Email preview in Missionaries view now perfectly matches live preview in Drips view and Brevo live dispatches.
• Hardware-Backed Version Bridge: Synchronized Android version code and auto-update flow.
